Question 1
?

Find the Cartesian equation of the curve defined parametrically by x=t,y=t(9−t),t≥0.

a
y=x2(3+x2),x≥0
b
y=x2(9−x2),x≥0
c
y=−x(3+x2),x≥0
d
y=2x2(9−x2),x≥0
e
y=−2x(9−x2),x≥0
Submit
